title: European optical-fiber clock network reanalysis (Pizzocaro et al. 2026, PRR 8, 033250)

conformal_holonomy_bound.observable_scope: Differential clock frequency-ratio consistency constraint across Doppler-cancelled link; 1 s star-tree closure (b1=0) is an algebraic data-processing check, while a model-independent disformal synchronization holonomy bound requires a physically closed b1>=1 fiber loop.

simultaneous_707bin_heteronuclear_YbE3_m.independent_column_shuffle_scope: Diagnostic only: independently shuffling ratios breaks shared-clock covariance; use joint UTC-block p-values for inference.

joint_utc_6h_block_null.method: Joint UTC-block date-label permutation; ratio vectors and within-block offsets retained.
joint_utc_6h_block_null.assumption: UTC blocks are exchangeable under the null; longer-range serial dependence is not preserved.

joint_utc_day_block_null.method: Joint UTC-block date-label permutation; ratio vectors and within-block offsets retained.
joint_utc_day_block_null.assumption: UTC blocks are exchangeable under the null; longer-range serial dependence is not preserved.

simultaneous_707bin_heteronuclear_YbE3_m.sampling_scope: Intersection of occupied 600 s bins; within-bin valid seconds can differ between ratios.
simultaneous_707bin_heteronuclear_YbE3_m.statistical_role: Joint-network consistency result across three contemporaneous ratios sharing clock inputs on the 4-clock NPL-PTB network.

star_topology_closure_audit.network_topology: Star tree centered on LNE-SYRTE (Paris); first Betti number b_1 = E - V + 1 = 3 - 4 + 1 = 0
star_topology_closure_audit.physical_interpretation: Simultaneous 1-second closure vanishes to 10^-20 - 10^-23 because the star-tree topology retraces identical fiber segments; Table II's 5.1-7.9 x 10^-18 campaign non-closure therefore proves temporal epoch-sampling drift across non-overlapping uptime windows sampling the time-varying tau_DL ~ 9-15 x 10^-18 sub-mHz floor.

zero_fiber_705km_antiphase_coherence.pair_1: NPL_YbE3-NPL_Sr1 (100% local at NPL, Teddington UK, 0 km fiber)

zero_fiber_705km_antiphase_coherence.predicted_phase_sign: negative (anti-phase, pi shift due to opposite-sign Delta K_alpha)
